caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal box with a hinged lid that is open, revealing the interior. The box has a gray metallic color with patches of rusted brown dispersed unevenly across its surface. On the inside of the lid, there is a decorative motif resembling a star made out of small punched holes arranged in a circular pattern, with two concentric rings of pointed rays. Inside the box, there are several compartments created by dividers, and a cylindrical container with holes around its upper edge rises from one of the compartments. The exterior of the box has parallel horizontal ridges running along its sides, and it stands on four short ball-shaped feet at the corners. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or scenery. Handwritten text is faintly visible near the bottom right and slightly above it on the lower right side of the lid.
title: Spice Box
